verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://plaid.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Many Identity Verification doc pages are served as agent-friendly markdown at index.html.md paths, including the product overview, webhooks, testing, Link and API reference, so an agent can be pointed at either. Missing for 10: no evidence the llms.txt specifically indexes the Identity Verification docs, no first-party guidance on using the docs with agents, the shorthand /identity-verification/.md path returns 404, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
